tagline.en: Early-career accounting professional researching sustainability reporting and firm value.
tagline.id: Profesional akuntansi awal karier yang meneliti pelaporan keberlanjutan dan nilai perusahaan.

bio.en: Specializing in tax compliance, auditing, and financial analysis — with ongoing research on how sustainability reporting affects firm value in Indonesian manufacturing. Previously a Tax Volunteer at DJP, serving 90+ taxpayers and running community outreach across Bantul Regency.
bio.id: Berfokus pada kepatuhan pajak, audit, dan analisis keuangan — dengan riset berkelanjutan tentang pengaruh pelaporan keberlanjutan terhadap nilai perusahaan manufaktur Indonesia. Sebelumnya Relawan Pajak di DJP, melayani 90+ wajib pajak dan menjalankan penyuluhan masyarakat di Kabupaten Bantul.

positioning.en: Early-career professional working at the intersection of financial reporting and sustainability disclosure.
positioning.id: Profesional awal karier yang bekerja di persimpangan pelaporan keuangan dan pengungkapan keberlanjutan.
